title: Hold a casino licence
what: Run a casino only under a casino licence granted by the Minister; the licence is what allows casino gaming that the Territory's gaming laws otherwise forbid (s 21).

sources.title: Gaming Control Act 1993 (NT)
sources.quote: A person may apply to the Minister to be granted a casino licence

sources.title: Gaming Control Act 1993 (NT)
sources.quote: Subject to this Act, nothing in a law of the Territory prevents a Licensee or a person employed by a Licensee from conducting the business permitted by the casino licence in a casino in accordance with the terms and conditions of the casino licence
